title.narrative: Strengthening rehabilitation and inclusive early childhood education for children with disabilities in Egypt
Stärkung der Rehabilitation und inklusiven frühkindlichen Bildung für Kinder mit Behinderung in Ägypten

description.narrative: Around 10.7 per cent of Egypts population lives with a disability, with around 75 per cent of them living in underserved rural areas and informal settlements. Only about 5 per cent of affected children and young people receive state support and have significantly less access to education. This is where the project comes in. It targets 500 children with intellectual and other developmental disabilities, 700 family members and carers, and 500 community members. The project works with six local development organisations, ten early childhood education institutions and 150 employees of government
